page.layout: One column of running text, with a short marginal note in the right margin beside the fourth line. Below the last line: a gathering signature at the left and a catchword at the right. Running head and page number at the top.

main_text.l: Dullartus se sinuant, in orâ aggeribus
idemque, ut dixi jam ante, secundùm
Hunesi lapsum fit non ab urbe solùm, sed
& supra urbem, usque ad ejusdem ostium.
In eâ post Groningam nobilissima & ma-
xima DAMMONA est, non vilis oppidi
rens, amœna, in circulum ferè se colli-
plo illustri cum turre latè spectabili insig-
plum, sed extra ambitum, lateri tamen
Augustinianae, nunc ab omni cultu de-
sertum, ac vix se sustinens: sita ad Fi-
intus connexa quinque; unde ad exitum

page.notes: Running head is printed as "Deque Vrbe Groninga."; the V is normalised to U. The page number "17" at the top right is read from a small scan and marked uncertain. Printed text is set in roman with long s; s is transcribed plainly. The section letter "B" and the catchword "amnis," sit at the foot. The initial word "feptentrionibus" begins the page as a fragment continuing from the previous page. The marginal note reads "DAMMONA." in small capitals, followed by a short dash-like mark.
